subject: EU-only hosting feasibility & SCCs operational checklist
messages:
From: Julia Stein <julia.stein@eurapulse.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@eurapulse.com
Date: Mon, 26 Nov 2029 09:18:00 +0100
Subject: Question: EU-only processing + SCCs evidence

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week — great product. Our procurement team needs to confirm a few items before we can proceed: we require EU-only processing for all customer data, evidence that standard contractual clauses (SCCs) are in place and how cross-border access is controlled, plus a retention/deletion matrix we can include in our security annex.

Can you share an operational checklist (logs, KMS ownership, backup retention, deletion procedures) and indicate whether Redwood will sign SCCs or if you require a different data transfer mechanism?

Appreciate a short writeup we can include with our vendor security review.

Best,
Julia
Julia Stein
Head of Procurement, Eurapulse Ltd

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Julia Stein <julia.stein@eurapulse.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Nov 2029 12:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question: EU-only processing + SCCs evidence

Hi Julia — thanks for the note and the clear list. I put together a short operational checklist and attached the evidence pack (see PDF). High-level answers:

- EU-only processing: Supported. We offer in-region hosting in multiple EU regions; customers can opt for EU-only routing and storage.
- SCCs: Redwood signs the EU Commission SCCs for controller-processor relationships. We also provide a documented transfer impact assessment (TIA) when requested.
- KMS & keys: Customers can request KMS integration; by default keys are Redwood-managed in EU regions but we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for Private deployments.
- Backups & retention: Backup copies are stored in-region with default 90-day retention; retention windows are configurable per contract.
- Deletion: We provide logical deletion APIs and physical deletion (secure wipe) processes; deletion confirmation with timestamps can be included in the evidence package.

I've attached: redwood-eu-sccs-evidence-checklist.pdf and a simplified data flow diagram. Naomi and Markus are looped in for the legal/controls details. Happy to join a short tech call if you want to walk through the checklist.

Next steps suggested:
- You confirm the set of data types to be isolated (PII vs telemetry).
- We provide a TIA + evidence bundle within 3 business days once we have the list.
- Schedule a 30-minute technical runthrough (Naomi/Marissa to join).

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Nov 2029 08:11:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Question: EU-only processing + SCCs evidence

Forwarding the ask from Eurapulse — procurement wants a concise operational checklist and confirmation about SCCs and KMS ownership. High-level is handled, but they may push on:
- Proof of in-region-only backups and restores (audit trail)
- KMS/customer key model for Private vs Dedicated vs Hosted
- Retention configurable per dataset with documented purge workflows and timestamps
- Access controls for support engineers (do we have break-glass/console access logs?)

Can you advise on the shortest evidence bundle we can share that won't leak internal architecture details but satisfies procurement? Also flag any contract clauses we should preempt (e.g., restrictive deletion SLA, audit rights).

Thanks — Diego

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Nov 2029 10:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Fwd: Question: EU-only processing + SCCs evidence

Diego / team,

We can provide a concise evidence bundle:
- Signed SCCs template (controller -> processor) and DPAs we can append; indicate any scoping restrictions.
- Transfer Impact Assessment summary (high-level findings only).
- KMS model doc: default Redwood-managed keys (EU), option for customer-managed KMS with key material stored in customer tenant (private deployments).
- Audit logs: support access logs + SOP for break-glass events.
- Retention/deletion matrix (dataset -> retention -> deletion proof sample with timestamp).

Two cautions:
1) Avoid sharing raw internal architecture diagrams that show staff access paths; provide redacted data flow diagram (we can use the attached PNG).
2) If they request continuous in-region-only guarantees in the contract (hard exclusivity), escalate to sales — that scope may require Dedicated or Private with contractual commitments.

I'll prepare a short SCCs cover letter and the redacted evidence bundle. Naomi, please confirm that the retention proof (sample deletion logs) can be exported for a single customer as redacted CSV.

Markus Klein
Head of Legal (Privacy & Security) | Redwood Inference

- A sample deletion proof (timestamped) for PII dataset.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call on Tue 3 Dec or Wed 4 Dec (EET) to walk the tech/legal owners through the bundle? Also, please send the DocuSign link once the SCCs template is ready and we'll route internally.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Julia
